version.config:
vrf {{ vrf }}
 address-family ipv4 unicast
  import route-target
   100:100
  !
  export route-target
   100:100
  !
 !
 address-family ipv6 unicast
 !
!
interface preconfigure {{ intf }}
 description {{ vrf }} Interface
 vrf {{ vrf }}
!

logging trap informational
logging console disable
logging history informational
logging monitor debugging
logging buffered 3072000
logging buffered debugging
logging buffered discriminator
 nomatch1 "service"
!
logging facility local7
logging {{ logging_server }} vrf {{ vrf }} severity info port default
!
logging source-interface {{ intf }} vrf {{ vrf }}
logging suppress duplicates
service timestamps log datetime localtime msec show-timezone
service timestamps debug datetime localtime msec show-timezone

snmp-server community {{ community }} RW
call-home
 service active
 contact smart-licensing
 profile {{ profile }}
  active
  destination transport-method email disable
  destination transport-method http
 !
! 
netconf agent tty
!

{# Phase 1 (Enable IPv6) for node-3 -- IOS-XE 17.18 PE (single-topology ISIS). #}
{# IPv6 ISIS is enabled per-interface via 'ipv6 router isis'; NO address-family #}
{# submode is used for single-topology (avoids NED 'exit-address-family' which  #}
{# IOS-XE 17.18 rejects). metric-style wide set at global router isis level.     #}
interface Loopback0
 ipv6 address 2010::3/128
 ipv6 router isis 1
!
interface Loopback2
 ipv6 address 2011::3/128
!
interface GigabitEthernet4
 ipv6 router isis 1
!
interface GigabitEthernet7
 ipv6 router isis 1
!
interface GigabitEthernet8
 ipv6 router isis 1
!
interface GigabitEthernet9
 ipv6 router isis 1
!
router isis 1
 metric-style wide
!

interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0/12
 description Connection to device pce-12 destination interface 8
 ipv4 address 10.8.12.8 255.255.255.0
 ipv6 address 2001::8:12:8/112
 ipv6 enable
!
router static
 address-family ipv4 unicast
  198.19.1.12/32 10.8.12.12
  198.19.2.12/32 10.8.12.12
 !
 address-family ipv6 unicast
  2010::12/128 2001::8:12:12
  2011::12/128 2001::8:12:12
 !
!
no mpls ldp

no mpls ldp router-id Loopback0 force
interface GigabitEthernet4
 no mpls ip
!
interface GigabitEthernet7
 no mpls ip
!
interface GigabitEthernet8
 no mpls ip
!

route-policy RRv6
 set local-preference {{ local_preference }}
 pass
end-policy
!

router bgp 65000
 address-family vpnv4 unicast
 exit
 address-family l2vpn evpn
 exit
 neighbor 2011::11
  remote-as 65000
  update-source Loopback0
  address-family vpnv4 unicast
  exit
  address-family l2vpn evpn
  exit
 exit
exit

route-policy RRv6
 set local-preference 150
 pass
end-policy
!

router bgp 65000
 neighbor 2011::11
  remote-as 65000
  update-source Loopback0
  address-family vpnv4 unicast
   encapsulation-type srv6
   route-policy RRv6 out
  !
 !

router bgp 65000

{# Phase 2 (deck steps 6a/6b): SRv6 locators TOP/MAIN/BOTTOM/LATENCY + ISISv6 SRv6 #}
{% set device_id = device.name.lstrip('node-') %}
segment-routing
 srv6
  locators
   locator TOP
    micro-segment behavior unode psp-usd
    prefix fcbb:2:{{ device_id }}::/48
    algorithm 129
    exit
   locator MAIN
    micro-segment behavior unode psp-usd
    prefix fcbb:0:{{ device_id }}::/48
    exit
   locator BOTTOM
    micro-segment behavior unode psp-usd
    prefix fcbb:3:{{ device_id }}::/48
    algorithm 130
    exit
   locator LATENCY
    micro-segment behavior unode psp-usd
    prefix fcbb:1:{{ device_id }}::/48
    algorithm 128
    exit
   exit
  exit
 exit

router isis 1
 address-family ipv6 unicast
  segment-routing srv6
   locator TOP
   exit
   locator MAIN
   exit
   locator BOTTOM
   exit
   locator LATENCY
   exit
  exit
 exit
exit

{# Phase 5 (deck step 7a/7c): PE BGP SRv6 session to RRv6 + per-VRF SRv6 locator MAIN #}
router bgp {{ local_as }}
  neighbor 2011::11
  remote-as {{ remote_as }}
  update-source {{ loopback }}
  address-family vpnv4 unicast
   encapsulation-type srv6
   route-policy RRv6 out
   exit
  exit
exit

router bgp {{ local_as }}
  vrf {{ vrf_name }}
    address-family ipv4 unicast
    mpls alloc enable
    segment-routing srv6
      locator MAIN
      alloc mode per-vrf
      exit
    exit
  exit
exit
